magma_graph — Multi-graph agentic memory using PostgreSQL + pgvector.

Implements MAGMA (arXiv:2601.03236) with relational tables: magma_nodes — memory items with embeddings (pgvector) magma_edges — typed edges: TEMPORAL, CAUSAL, MENTIONS, ABOUT

Four orthogonal graphs: Temporal: ordered chain (n_prev → n_curr) by timestamp Causal: LLM-inferred cause→effect edges Semantic: pgvector cosine similarity (implicit graph) Entity: event ↔ entity edges (MENTIONS, ABOUT)

Compile with -d:withPostgres to activate. Without the flag the module exports only stub types.
